words.en: Camouflage is the way in which some animals are colored and shaped so that they cannot easily be seen in their natural surroundings.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr: phrase. 数据收集；资料采集
words.ex: The teacher uses data collection to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用数据收集来检查学生的进步。
words.en: The process of gathering information or data from various sources for analysis or processing.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: She spent the afternoon tagging all her clothes with her name.
words.ex_cn: 她花了整个下午给她的所有衣服都加上了她的名字标签。
words.en: The act of attaching a tag to something or someone for identification or other purposes.

words.tr: v. 监控（无线电或电视传输信号）；监视；监控（无线电或电视传输信号）（monitor 的现在分词）；
words.ex: The team is monitoring radio signals for errors.
words.ex_cn: 团队正在监控无线电信号以查找错误。
words.en: The act of observing and checking the progress or quality of something over a period of time; keeping under systematic review.

words.tr:
n. 风味；味道；
v. 给…添风味；
words.ex: This ice cream has a sweet flavour.
words.ex_cn: 这种冰淇淋有甜美的风味。
words.en: Flavour is the taste of a food or drink, especially when it is pleasant and distinctive.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.ex: The soldier wore camouflage to hide in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 士兵穿着伪装服在森林中隐藏自己。
words.en: Camouflage is the way in which some animals are colored and shaped so that they cannot easily be seen in their natural surroundings.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: He takes public transport to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transport refers to the system of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: He takes the metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A metro is an underground railway system in a city.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.ex: He uses a simple research method to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一种简单的研究方法来收集数据。
words.en: A systematic approach used to collect and analyze data to answer research questions or test hypotheses.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: phrase. 学术写作；指在学术环境中用于表达研究、论证和分析的正式写作风格
words.ex: He practices academic writing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习学术写作。
words.en: Academic writing is a style of expression that researchers use to define the intellectual boundaries of their disciplines and specific areas of expertise.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: phrase. 在线数据库；可通过网络访问并查询的数据集合
words.ex: He uses an online database to find books.
words.ex_cn: 他使用在线数据库查找书籍。
words.en: An online database is a database accessible from a network, including from the Internet.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 娱乐活动；休闲活动；消遣活动
words.ex: They play soccer as a recreational activity on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末把踢足球当作娱乐活动。
words.en: Activities done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The river suffered from contamination after the factory dumped waste.
words.ex_cn: 工厂倾倒废物后，这条河受到了污染。
words.en: The process of making something dirty or polluted, or the state of being dirty or polluted.

words.tr: phrase. 可再生能源（指可自然补充的能源，如太阳能、风能、水能等）
words.ex: The town uses renewable energy to power its lights.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用可再生能源来供电。
words.en: Renewable energy is energy that is collected from renewable resources, which are naturally replenished on a human timescale, such as sunlight, wind, rain, tides, waves, and geothermal heat.

words.ex: The house uses solar power to light the rooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子使用太阳能来照明房间。
words.en: Solar power is energy from the sun that is converted into thermal or electrical energy.

words.ex: The farm uses wind energy to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场利用风能发电。
words.en: Wind energy is power obtained by harnessing the energy of the wind.

words.ex: The village uses hydro power to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄用水力发电。
words.en: Hydro power refers to the generation of electrical power through the use of the gravitational force of falling or flowing water.

words.ex: Farmers grow crops like wheat and corn.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和玉米等农作物。
words.en: Crops are plants such as wheat and potatoes that are grown in large quantities for food.

words.tr: n. 植物；发电厂；工厂；作物；“plant”的复数；
words.ex: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要阳光和水来生长。
words.en: Plants are living organisms that typically grow in soil and have leaves, stems, and roots. They are essential for the environment as they produce oxygen and provide food for many animals.

words.tr: phrase. 自然灾害（如地震、洪水、飓风等）
words.ex: The earthquake was a natural disaster.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场自然灾害。
words.en: A natural disaster is a major adverse event resulting from natural processes of the Earth; examples include floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, tsunamis, and other geologic processes.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.tr: n. 制造业； v. 制造；“manufacture”的现在分词；
words.ex: Manufacturing is important for the country's economy.
words.ex_cn: 制造业对国家经济很重要。
words.en: The process of converting raw materials into finished products, especially by means of a large-scale industrial operation.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服了药。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.tr: phrase. 家用电器（指家庭中使用的各种电器设备，如冰箱、洗衣机、微波炉等）
words.ex: She bought new household appliances for her kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她为厨房买了新的家用电器。
words.en: Household appliances refer to electrical/mechanical machines which accomplish some household functions, such as cooking or cleaning.

words.tr: adj. 有益的；值得的； v. “reward”的现在分词；
words.ex: Volunteering is a rewarding experience.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务是一种有益的经历。
words.en: Providing satisfaction or gratification; beneficial.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.tr: adj. 有影响力的；有效的
words.ex: Her speech was impactful and moved everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲很有影响力，打动了所有人。
words.en: Having a significant impact or effect.

words.tr: 短语动词. 产生重大影响；对……有巨大作用
words.ex: The new policy will have a great impact on the economy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策将对经济产生巨大影响。
words.en: To have a significant or powerful effect on someone or something.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr: adj. 结构良好的；组织得好的
words.ex: He wrote a well-structured essay.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇结构清晰的作文。
words.en: A well-structured system, organization, or activity is one that is organized in a clear and logical way.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.tr: phrase. 过于雄心勃勃的；野心过大的
words.ex: He is too ambitious to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 他太有野心了，不可能在一周内完成这个项目。
words.en: Excessively difficult or grand in scale to be realistically achieved.

words.ex: The results are difficult to evaluate because the data is incomplete.
words.ex_cn: 这些结果难以评估，因为数据不完整。

words.tr: phrase. 不够具有挑战性的；不够有难度的
words.ex: The math test was not sufficiently challenging for the top students.
words.ex_cn: 这次数学考试对尖子生来说不够有挑战性。
words.en: adj. not difficult enough to test someone's abilities or knowledge

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人能力范围的；力所不能及的
words.ex: This math problem is beyond my ability.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题超出了我的能力。
words.en: Exceeding one's capacity or capability

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实用的；
words.ex: It's impractical to walk to work every day if you live 50 kilometers away.
words.ex_cn: 如果你住得离工作地点50公里远，每天步行上班是不切实际的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as impractical, you mean that they are not good at planning or organizing things in a practical way, or that their ideas or methods are not suitable for a particular situation.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏清晰度；不明确
words.ex: His explanation lacks clarity.
words.ex_cn: 他的解释缺乏清晰度。

words.tr: phrase. 过于复杂的；过分繁复的
words.ex: The instructions are overly complex for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对初学者来说过于复杂。
words.en: Excessively complicated or intricate; more complex than necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 已经完成（表示某事早已做完）

words.ex: The scientist requires further data to confirm the result.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家需要更多数据来确认结果。

words.tr: 需要更多专注；需要更加集中注意力
words.ex: I need more focus to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要更多专注来完成作业。

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr: phrase. 到期日；截止日期；预产期
words.ex: The due date for the homework is Friday.
words.ex_cn: 作业的截止日期是星期五。
words.en: The date by which something is expected to happen or be completed.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: He uses a simple research method to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一种简单的研究方法来收集数据。
words.en: A systematic approach used to collect and analyze data to answer research questions or test hypotheses.

words.tr: phrase. 数据收集；资料采集
words.ex: The teacher uses data collection to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用数据收集来检查学生的进步。
words.en: The process of gathering information or data from various sources for analysis or processing.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: 短语动词. 注册参加；登记入学；加入（课程、学校等）
words.ex: He will enroll in English class next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将报名参加英语课。
words.en: To officially register or join a course, program, or institution.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr: 博士论文答辩：博士生在完成博士学位论文后，进行的公开口试，向考官们展示并辩护自己的论文，是获得博士学...
words.ex: She successfully completed her thesis defense and was awarded the PhD.
words.ex_cn: 她成功完成了博士论文答辩，并被授予博士学位。
words.en: The act of presenting and defending the ideas and research of a thesis to a panel of experts, typically as part of the requirements for a graduate degree.

words.tr: phrase. 紧迫的截止期限；时间紧迫的最后期限
words.ex: The team worked overtime to meet the tight deadline.
words.ex_cn: 团队为了赶上紧迫的截止日期而加班工作。
words.en: A tight deadline is a very limited amount of time given to complete a task or project.

words.tr: phrase. 繁重的工作量；大量的工作任务
words.ex: He has a heavy workload this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周工作量很大。
words.en: A heavy workload refers to a large amount of work that a person has to do, often leading to stress or difficulty in managing time effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 资源不足；缺乏资源
words.ex: The school has a lack of resources for science classes.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校科学课程的资源不足。
words.en: A state of not having enough money, materials, or support to meet needs or achieve goals.

words.tr: phrase. 模糊的指南；不明确的指导原则
words.ex: The unclear guidelines made it hard for students to follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 模糊的指南让学生们难以遵循规则。

words.tr: phrase. 技术问题；技术性故障
words.ex: The team faced a technical problem during the race.
words.ex_cn: 在比赛中，团队遇到了一个技术问题。
words.en: A technical problem is a difficulty or issue related to the practical, especially mechanical or scientific, aspects of something.

words.tr: phrase. 分析困难；难以分析
words.ex: He showed difficulty in analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他在数据分析上遇到了困难。

words.tr: phrase. 小组成员问题；团队成员纠纷
words.ex: The group member issue caused delays in the project.
words.ex_cn: 小组成员问题导致了项目延误。

words.tr: phrase. 缩小话题范围；将主题聚焦到更具体的方面
words.ex: We need to narrow down the topic for our project.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要为我们的项目缩小话题范围。

words.tr: phrase. 改变方法；更改研究或操作的方法
words.ex: They changed the methodology to get better results.
words.ex_cn: 他们改变了方法以获得更好的结果。

words.tr: 短语动词. 请求延期；要求延长截止时间
words.ex: He will ask for an extension on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他会请求延长作业的截止时间。
words.en: Request additional time to complete a task or assignment.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询导师；向导师请教
words.ex: If you have any questions, don't hesitate to consult the tutor.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有任何问题，不要犹豫，去向导师请教。
words.en: To seek advice or information from an expert or professional, especially a teacher.

words.tr: phrase. 做更多的背景阅读
words.ex: You should do more background reading before writing the essay.
words.ex_cn: 在写论文之前，你应该做更多的背景阅读。

words.ex: He uses different sources to find the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他使用不同的来源来寻找真相。

words.ex: He decided to join a study group to prepare for the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他决定加入一个学习小组来准备数学考试。
words.en: To join a study group is to become part of a small team of students who meet regularly to discuss and learn course material together.

words.ex: He waited at the airport terminal for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场航站楼等他的航班。
words.en: The building at an airport where passengers transfer between ground transportation and the facilities that allow them to board and disembark from aircraft.

words.tr: phrase. 办理登机手续的柜台；登记入住的柜台
words.ex: He went to the check-in counter to get his boarding pass.
words.ex_cn: 他去值机柜台拿登机牌。
words.en: A check-in counter is a place at an airport where passengers go to register for a flight and check their luggage before boarding.

words.tr: phrase. 办理登机手续的柜台；登记处
words.ex: He went to the check-in desk to get his boarding pass.
words.ex_cn: 他去值机柜台拿登机牌。
words.en: A check-in desk is a counter at an airport where you go to say that you have arrived for your flight and to get your boarding pass.

words.tr: phrase. 登机牌；用于登机时的身份凭证
words.ex: He showed his boarding pass at the gate.
words.ex_cn: 他在登机口出示了登机牌。
words.en: A boarding pass is a document provided by an airline during check-in, giving a passenger permission to board the airplane for a particular flight.

words.ex: The plane will depart from boarding gate 12.
words.ex_cn: 飞机将从12号登机口起飞。
words.en: A boarding gate is the area in an airport where passengers wait to board their flight.

words.ex: He is waiting in the departure lounge.
words.ex_cn: 他正在候机厅等待。
words.en: A departure lounge is a waiting room in an airport or railway station where passengers wait before boarding their transport.

words.tr: phrase. 到达休息室；机场或车站供到达旅客等候和休息的区域
words.ex: We waited in the arrival lounge for our luggage.
words.ex_cn: 我们在到达休息室等候行李。

words.tr: n. 临时滞留；中途停留；短暂停留
words.ex: We had a short layover in Dubai.
words.ex_cn: 我们在迪拜有一个短暂的中转。
words.en: A layover is a short stay in a place in between parts of a journey, especially a wait between airplane flights.

words.ex: We had a stopover in Dubai on our way to Sydney.
words.ex_cn: 我们在飞往悉尼的途中在迪拜中途停留。
words.en: A stopover is a short stay in a place in between parts of a journey, especially a long journey.

words.ex: We took a direct flight to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘坐了直飞巴黎的航班。
words.en: A flight that goes from one place to another without any stops.

words.ex: He took a non-stop flight to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了一趟直达纽约的航班。
words.en: A non-stop flight is a flight that travels directly from one place to another without any stops.

words.tr: phrase. 乘务员；空中服务员（在飞机上为乘客提供服务的人员）
words.ex: The flight attendant gave us drinks on the plane.
words.ex_cn: 空乘人员在飞机上给我们提供了饮料。
words.en: A flight attendant is a person whose job is to serve and take care of passengers on an aircraft.

words.tr: phrase. 行李认领处；行李提取区
words.ex: He is waiting at the baggage claim.
words.ex_cn: 他正在行李领取处等候。
words.en: The area in an airport where arriving passengers collect their luggage.

words.tr: n. 旋转木马；行李传送带
words.ex: The children laugh on the carousel.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旋转木马上大笑。
words.en: A carousel is a large circular machine with seats, often in the shape of animals or vehicles, on which people, especially children, ride for amusement at a fair or amusement park. It can also refer to a conveyor system at an airport that moves luggage around in a circle so that passengers can collect it.

words.ex: The shuttle bus takes us to the airport every hour.
words.ex_cn: 班车每小时接送我们去机场。
words.en: A shuttle bus is a bus that travels regularly between two places, especially a bus that takes people to and from an airport or between different parts of a city.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车租赁；租车服务
words.ex: We booked a car rental for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了汽车租赁。
words.en: The service of renting cars for a short period of time, usually ranging from a few hours to a few weeks.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.tr:
n. 乘船游览；航游；
v. 乘船游览；航游；
words.ex: We went on a cruise around the Mediterranean Sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘船游览了地中海。
words.en: To sail about in an area without a precise destination, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.tr: phrase. 直升机观光；乘直升机进行的空中游览
words.ex: We took a helicopter tour over the Grand Canyon.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘坐直升机在大峡谷上空进行了观光。
words.en: A helicopter tour is a sightseeing trip conducted by a helicopter, offering a unique aerial perspective of the landscape.

words.ex: The tourists rode the cable car up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 游客们乘坐缆车上了山。
words.en: A cable car is a vehicle that is pulled by a moving cable and is used for transporting people up and down mountains.

words.ex: He drives a car with four-wheel drive.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆四轮驱动的车。
words.en: A four-wheel drive is a vehicle that is capable of transmitting power to all four wheels simultaneously, providing better traction especially on slippery or uneven surfaces.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.tr: abbr. 出账薄；“Bill Book”的缩写
words.ex: The accountant checked the bb for last month's expenses.
words.ex_cn: 会计检查了上个月的出账薄。
words.en: A term of address for a friend or acquaintance.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.ex: We rented a camper van for our road trip across the country.
words.ex_cn: 我们租了一辆露营车进行我们的全国公路旅行。
words.en: A camper van is a type of vehicle that is equipped with living facilities and is used for camping or traveling.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: He booked a single room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他预订了一个单人房间过夜。
words.en: A single room is a hotel room designed for one person, containing one single bed.

words.ex: We booked a double room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room intended for two people, typically containing a double bed.

words.tr: phrase. 带两张单人床的双人房
words.ex: We booked a twin room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room with two single beds, typically for two people.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.ex: The hotel room has an en-suite bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 这个酒店房间有一个内嵌浴室。
words.en: A bathroom that is directly connected to a bedroom, forming part of a suite.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: The room has air conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: Air conditioning is a system or process that controls the temperature, humidity, and sometimes the purity of the air in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr: phrase. 套餐菜单；固定菜单（指餐厅中预先搭配好的固定菜品组合）
words.ex: We ordered the set menu for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们晚餐点了套餐。
words.en: A fixed-price meal offered by a restaurant, featuring a selection of dishes at a set cost.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊饮食需求；指因健康、宗教、过敏或其他原因而需遵循的特定饮食限制或要求
words.ex: The restaurant can meet special dietary requirements.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅可以满足特殊的饮食需求。
words.en: Specific nutritional needs or restrictions that an individual may have, often due to health, ethical, or religious reasons.

words.ex: We went on a sightseeing tour of the city.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了城市的观光游。
words.en: A sightseeing tour is a trip or excursion for the purpose of seeing sights of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.tr:
n. 远足；郊游；短途旅行
v. 使熄灭；揭露；驱逐；“out”的现在分词
words.ex: We went on a school outing last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去学校组织的郊游了。
words.en: An outing is a short trip that you go on for pleasure or education, often with a group of people.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.tr: v. （尤指在山中）远足，徒步旅行，游山玩水；艰苦跋涉，徒步旅行( trek的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They went trekking in the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末去山里徒步旅行了。
words.en: Trekking is an activity that involves walking long distances, especially in the countryside or mountains.

words.ex: He is snorkeling near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 他正在珊瑚礁附近浮潜。
words.en: Snorkeling is the practice of swimming on or through a body of water while equipped with a diving mask, a shaped breathing tube called a snorkel, and usually fins.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.tr: phrase. 野生动物观光之旅；在自然栖息地观察野生动物的旅行
words.ex: We went on a wildlife safari in the African savanna and saw lions, elephants, and giraffes.
words.ex_cn: 我们在非洲大草原上进行了一次野生动物观察之旅，看到了狮子、大象和长颈鹿。
words.en: A trip or expedition to observe or hunt wild animals in their natural habitat.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术展览；美术展览
words.ex: They visited an art exhibition last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了一个艺术展览。
words.en: An art exhibition is a public display of works of art, often in a museum or gallery, where people can view and appreciate the artwork.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.tr: phrase. 历史遗址；具有历史意义的地点
words.ex: We visited a historical site last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个历史遗址。
words.en: A historical site is a place where important historical events occurred or which is associated with significant historical figures.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: We visited a national park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个国家公园。
words.en: A national park is an area of land that is protected by the government because of its natural beauty, plants, or animals, and is open to the public for enjoyment and education.

words.tr: phrase. 植物园；专门用于种植和展示各种植物的园区
words.ex: We walked in the botanical garden and saw many flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我们在植物园里散步，看到了许多花。
words.en: A botanical garden is a place where plants are grown for scientific study and display to the public.

words.ex: The cat hid behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 猫躲到了灌木丛后面。
words.en: A bush is a plant which is much smaller than a tree and has a lot of branches.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: The children saw a big rainforest on their trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旅行中看到了一片热带雨林。
words.en: A dense, tropical forest that receives a high amount of rainfall, typically located near the equator.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: The children play by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边玩耍。
words.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天都举办音乐节。
words.en: A festival is an organized series of events such as musical concerts or drama productions, often happening annually in the same place.

words.ex: He wears sunglasses on sunny days.
words.ex_cn: 他在晴天戴太阳镜。
words.en: Sunglasses are glasses with dark lenses which you wear to protect your eyes from bright sunlight.

words.ex: He puts on sunscreen before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩前涂防晒霜。
words.en: A sunscreen is a cream that you put on your skin to protect it from the sun's rays.

words.ex: He puts on sunblock before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩前涂上防晒霜。
words.en: A cream or lotion applied to the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays.

words.ex: He uses insect repellent to avoid mosquito bites.
words.ex_cn: 他使用驱虫剂来避免被蚊子叮咬。
words.en: A substance that deters insects from approaching or settling.

words.tr: phrase. 防水夹克；防水外套
words.ex: He wears a waterproof jacket when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨时，他穿一件防水夹克。
words.en: A jacket made of material that does not allow water to pass through it.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图找路。
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.ex: He bought a guidebook for his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他为去巴黎旅行买了一本旅游指南。
words.en: A guidebook is a book that gives tourists information about a town, area, or country.

words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报说明天会下雨。
words.en: A weather forecast is a statement saying what the weather is expected to be like the next day or for the next few days.

words.tr: adj. 阳光灿烂的；晴朗的；
words.ex: It is a sunny day today.
words.ex_cn: 今天是阳光灿烂的一天。
words.en: When it is sunny, the sun is shining brightly.

words.ex: It was a rainy day, so we stayed inside.
words.ex_cn: 那天是多雨的，所以我们待在室内。
words.en: If the weather is rainy, it is raining a lot.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: The island has a mild climate all year round.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿全年气候温和。
words.en: A mild climate refers to an area that experiences moderate temperatures and weather conditions, not too hot or too cold, making it pleasant for living and agriculture.

words.tr: phrase. 失物；遗失物品；失物招领处
words.ex: He found his wallet in the lost property office.
words.ex_cn: 他在失物招领处找到了他的钱包。
words.en: Items that have been lost and are waiting to be reclaimed by their owners.

words.ex: My passport was stolen while I was on vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我的护照在度假时被盗了。

words.ex: The flight delayed because of heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于大雨，航班延误了。

words.ex: The flight cancelled because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 航班因风暴而取消。

words.tr: adj. 预订过多的；超售的
words.ex: The hotel is overbooked tonight.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店今晚订满了。
words.en: Having sold more tickets or allocated more resources than are available, leading to overcapacity.

words.tr: phrase. 飞行时差反应；时差感
words.ex: He feels tired because of jet lag.
words.ex_cn: 他因为时差而感到疲倦。
words.en: A temporary disorder that causes fatigue, insomnia, and other symptoms as a result of rapid travel across several time zones.

words.ex: The tour guide showed us the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古老的城堡。
words.en: A tour guide is a person who leads groups of people around a town, museum, or other tourist attraction, providing information about the place.

words.tr: phrase. 旅行社代理人；旅游中介
words.ex: I called a travel agent to book my flight.
words.ex_cn: 我打电话给旅行社帮我预订航班。
words.en: A travel agent is a person or company that arranges travel for individuals or groups.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: Can you tell me how to get there?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我如何到达那里吗？

words.tr: phrase. 旅行方式；出行方式
words.ex: Biking is a healthy way of travel.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车是一种健康的旅行方式。

words.ex: Buses and bikes are common means of transport in the city.
words.ex_cn: 公交车和自行车是城市里常见的交通工具。
words.en: A means of transport is a type of vehicle or system used for moving people or goods from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 住宿的地方；停留的场所
words.ex: We found a cheap place to stay near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 我们在火车站附近找到了一个便宜的住宿地方。

words.tr: phrase. 你将要睡觉的地方
phrase. 饮食安排；用餐安排
words.ex: The hotel made new eating arrangements for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为客人安排了新的饮食安排。

words.tr: v. 满足需要；“cater”的现在分词； n. 包办饮食；
words.ex: The new service is catering to the needs of students.
words.ex_cn: 这项新服务正在满足学生的需求。
words.en: The business of providing food and drink for events or occasions.

words.tr: n. 一餐；一顿饭；“meal”的复数；
words.ex: We eat three meals a day.
words.ex_cn: 我们一天吃三餐。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: They enjoy visiting the famous places in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢参观巴黎的著名景点。

words.tr: phrase. 城市游览；参观城市
words.ex: We took a tour of the city on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周六进行了城市游览。

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.ex: You can get free shipping at no extra cost.
words.ex_cn: 你可以免费送货，无需额外付费。
words.en: Without any additional payment required.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.tr: adj. 适合家庭的; 有利于家庭生活的
words.ex: This park is family-friendly.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园适合家庭。
words.en: Suitable for or not harmful to families; designed to be suitable for children as well as adults.

words.tr: phrase. 适合所有年龄段的
words.ex: This book is good for all ages.
words.ex_cn: 这本书适合所有年龄段的人。

words.ex: The cartoon is colorful and funny, kids will love it.
words.ex_cn: 这个动画片色彩鲜艳又有趣，孩子们会喜欢它。

words.ex: You need to book in advance to get a seat on the train.
words.ex_cn: 你需要提前预订才能买到火车票。

words.tr: phrase. 预订是必不可少的
words.ex: Reservations are essential if you want to eat at the restaurant on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想在周六去这家餐厅吃饭，预订是必不可少的。

words.ex: You must reserve a spot for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 你必须为这场音乐会预订一个位置。

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The job is demanding because it needs long hours and high focus.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求高，因为它需要长时间工作和高度专注。
words.en: Requiring much effort or attention; exacting.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: Don't forget to take your umbrella with you.
words.ex_cn: 别忘了带上你的伞。

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr: phrase. 商业战略；企业为实现长期目标而制定的竞争计划和资源配置方案
words.ex: Developing a clear business strategy is essential for any company to succeed.
words.ex_cn: 制定清晰的商业策略对任何公司的成功都是至关重要的。
words.en: A business strategy is a plan that outlines how a business intends to achieve its goals and objectives, often involving the allocation of resources to pursue these aims.

words.ex: He established a company last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年成立了一家公司。

words.ex: She decided to set up a business selling handmade crafts.
words.ex_cn: 她决定创业，销售手工工艺品。
words.en: To establish or start a new business venture.

words.ex: He wrote a simple business plan to start a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份简单的商业计划来开一家咖啡店。
words.en: A business plan is a formal statement of business goals, reasons they are attainable, and plans for reaching them. It may also contain background information about the organization or team attempting to reach those goals.

words.tr: phrase. 市场调研；市场研究（指通过调查分析消费者需求、市场趋势等以支持商业决策）
words.ex: The company did market research before launching the new product.
words.ex_cn: 公司在推出新产品之前做了市场调研。
words.en: Market research is the process of gathering, analyzing, and interpreting information about a market, about a product or service to be offered for sale in that market, and about the past, present, and potential customers for the product or service.

words.tr: phrase. 目标市场；企业计划销售产品或服务的特定消费者群体
words.ex: The company conducted extensive research to identify its target market.
words.ex_cn: 公司进行了广泛的研究以确定其目标市场。
words.en: A target market is a specific group of consumers at which a company aims its products and services.

words.tr: phrase. 目标客户；企业产品或服务所针对的特定消费群体
words.ex: Our target customer is young professionals who value sustainability.
words.ex_cn: 我们的目标客户是重视可持续性的年轻专业人士。
words.en: A target customer is a specific group of consumers at which a company aims its products and services.

words.tr: phrase. 竞争优势；企业或个人在市场竞争中相对于竞争对手所具备的有利条件或优势
words.ex: This company has a competitive advantage because its products are cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司因为产品更便宜而具有竞争优势。
words.en: A condition or circumstance that puts a company in a favorable or superior business position.

words.tr: phrase. 利基市场；小众市场；缝隙市场
words.ex: The company specializes in catering to niche markets.
words.ex_cn: 该公司专门从事服务于缝隙市场。
words.en: A niche market is the subset of the market on which a specific product is focused. The market niche defines the product features aimed at satisfying specific market needs, as well as the price range, production quality and the demographics that it is intended to target. It is also a small market segment.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.tr: n. 总部；司令部；指挥部；
words.ex: The company's headquarters is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a company, organization, or military unit.

words.tr: n. （企业或机构使用的）房屋及土地；“premise”的复数；
words.ex: The company owns its premises in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司拥有位于市中心的房产和土地。
words.en: The buildings and land that a business or organization uses.

words.tr: phrase. 分阶段地；逐步地；分批地
words.ex: He built the house in stages.
words.ex_cn: 他分阶段建了房子。
words.en: If something is done in stages, it is done in parts or steps rather than all at once.

words.ex: He improved his English phase by phase.
words.ex_cn: 他逐步地提高了他的英语。

words.ex: The manager checks the daily operations every morning.
words.ex_cn: 经理每天早上检查日常运营。

words.ex: The company fixes problems in its supply chain.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司解决其供应链中的问题。
words.en: A supply chain is a system of organizations, people, activities, information, and resources involved in moving a product or service from supplier to customer.

words.tr: phrase. 质量管理；品质控制
words.ex: The factory has strict quality control to make sure products are safe.
words.ex_cn: 工厂有严格的质量管理以确保产品安全。
words.en: Quality control is a process through which a business seeks to ensure that product quality is maintained or improved.

words.tr: adj. 有成本效益的；划算的
words.ex: This bike is cost-effective and saves money.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车物有所值，能省钱。
words.en: Something that is cost-effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.tr: phrase. 财务报表；财务报告（用于反映企业财务状况和经营成果的正式文件）
words.ex: The company shows its financial statements every year.
words.ex_cn: 公司每年展示其财务报表。
words.en: Formal records of a company's financial performance, including balance sheets and income statements.

words.tr: n. 盈利能力；盈利性；收益率
words.ex: The company checks its profitability every month.
words.ex_cn: 公司每个月检查它的盈利能力。
words.en: Profitability is the state or condition of yielding a financial profit or gain.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.tr: n. 成本；费用；“cost”的复数； v. 花费；
words.ex: The costs of buying a new car are high.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车的成本很高。
words.en: Costs refer to the amount of money that is required to purchase, produce, or maintain something, or the effort, loss, or sacrifice necessary to achieve or obtain something.

words.ex: The family reduced their monthly expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭减少了每月的开支。
words.en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 打成平手；得失相当
words.ex: After selling 100 tickets, the theater broke even.
words.ex_cn: 卖了100张票后，剧院打成了平手。
words.en: To reach a point in a business where the costs and the revenue are equal, so that there is neither profit nor loss.

words.tr: 短语动词. 破产；倒闭
words.ex: He went bankrupt after the business failed.
words.ex_cn: 他的生意失败后破产了。
words.en: To go bankrupt means to become unable to pay one's debts and thus to have one's financial affairs administered under the bankruptcy laws.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: The company is improving its recruitment process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在改进它的招聘流程。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company or organization.

words.tr: n. 雇佣；租赁； v. 雇用；租用；“hire”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company is focusing on hiring new staff.
words.ex_cn: 公司正专注于雇佣新员工。
words.en: The act of employing or engaging the services of someone for wages or other payment.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: n. 再训练； v. “retrain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company offered retraining for workers who lost their jobs.
words.ex_cn: 公司为失业的员工提供了再训练。
words.en: The process of learning new skills or being taught new skills, especially in order to be able to do a different job or to improve your performance in your current job.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.tr: phrase. 专业知识；专门知识
words.ex: He has specialist knowledge in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有计算机科学方面的专业知识。
words.en: Specialist knowledge refers to expert understanding or skill in a particular subject or field, often acquired through extensive study or experience.

words.tr: phrase. 员工士气；职员的精神状态或工作积极性
words.ex: The new manager improved staff morale.
words.ex_cn: 新经理提高了员工的士气。
words.en: The collective mood, satisfaction, and motivation level of employees within an organization.

words.ex: The company improved staff satisfaction by giving better benefits.
words.ex_cn: 公司通过提供更好的福利提高了员工满意度。

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 激励机制；奖励方案；鼓励计划
words.ex: The company offers an incentive scheme for good performance.
words.ex_cn: 公司为良好表现提供激励计划。
words.en: A structured plan or system designed to motivate people by offering rewards for achieving targets.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.tr: phrase. 营销活动；市场推广活动；广告宣传活动
words.ex: The company launched a new marketing campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的营销活动。
words.en: A marketing campaign is a series of advertisement messages that share a single idea and theme which make up an integrated marketing communication (IMC).

words.ex: The company wants to increase brand awareness through ads.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想通过广告提高品牌知名度。
words.en: The extent to which consumers are familiar with the distinctive qualities or image of a particular brand of goods or services.

words.ex: Customers show brand loyalty by buying the same soda every week.
words.ex_cn: 顾客每周都买同样的苏打水，表现出品牌忠诚。
words.en: Brand loyalty refers to the tendency of consumers to continue buying the same brand of goods rather than competing brands.

words.ex: The company values customer feedback to improve its products.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视客户反馈以改进其产品。
words.en: Customer feedback refers to the opinions, comments, and suggestions provided by customers about a product or service, which can be used to improve quality and customer satisfaction.

words.ex: The company offers good after-sales service.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供良好的售后服务。
words.en: After-sales service refers to the support and services provided to customers after they have purchased a product or service. This can include maintenance, repairs, and customer support.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 员工高流动率；人员频繁更替
words.ex: The company has high staff turnover because salaries are low.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司员工流动率很高，因为工资很低。
words.en: A high rate of employees leaving and being replaced.

words.tr: phrase. 现金流不佳；资金周转困难
words.ex: The small business struggled because of poor cash flow.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业因现金流不佳而陷入困境。

words.tr: phrase. 激烈的竞争；紧张的角逐
words.ex: There is intense competition for the top score.
words.ex_cn: 最高分的竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Intense competition refers to a situation in which businesses or individuals compete very strongly with each other, often leading to significant pressure to improve products, services, or performance.

words.tr: phrase. 过时的技术；陈旧的技术
words.ex: The factory still uses outdated technology.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂仍在使用过时的技术。
words.en: Technology that is no longer current or in widespread use.

words.ex: The store has low customer satisfaction because of long wait times.
words.ex_cn: 由于等待时间长，这家商店的客户满意度很低。

words.ex: The team faced criticism for failure to meet targets last quarter.
words.ex_cn: 该团队因上个季度未能达到目标而受到批评。

words.tr: phrase. 主要目标；核心目的
words.ex: His main aim is to finish school.
words.ex_cn: 他的主要目标是完成学业。
words.en: The principal objective or primary goal one seeks to achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 首要目标；主要目的
words.ex: His primary objective is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的主要目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: The main goal or aim that is most important.

words.ex: What they hoped to achieve was a better life for their children.
words.ex_cn: 他们希望实现的目标是为孩子们创造更好的生活。

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.ex: The team exceeded targets last quarter.
words.ex_cn: 团队上个季度超过了目标。

words.tr: v. 失败；无法做到；不及格；“fail”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He failed the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他数学考试没及格。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 未达到预期；未能如愿
words.ex: The team fell short of expectations in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在决赛中未达到预期。

words.tr: 短语动词. 请求建议；征求意见
words.ex: He asks for advice when he feels confused.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到困惑时，他会寻求建议。
words.en: To seek guidance or recommendations from someone, especially when making a decision.

words.tr: 短语动词. 咨询专家；向专家请教
words.ex: He will consult an expert about his problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将向专家咨询他的问题。
words.en: Seek advice or information from someone with specialized knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 稳步增长；持续增加
words.ex: The number of students increases steadily every year.
words.ex_cn: 学生人数每年都在稳步增加。
words.en: To grow or become larger in quantity or degree at a consistent and gradual rate.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.ex: The school was established in 2005.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校于2005年建立。

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.tr: adj. 令人失望的；令人扫兴的； v. “disappoint”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was disappointing.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影令人失望。
words.en: If something is disappointing, it is not as good as you hoped it would be.

words.ex: It's risky to walk alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 晚上独自走路是危险的。
words.en: If an activity or action is risky, it is dangerous or likely to fail.

words.ex: She shops at chain stores because they are cheap.
words.ex_cn: 她去连锁店购物，因为它们很便宜。
words.en: A chain store is a retail outlet that is part of a larger company that operates multiple stores. These stores share a brand and central management, and usually have standardized business methods and practices.

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.tr: phrase. 未来发展；将来的开发或进步
words.ex: The city plans for future development near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划在河边进行未来发展。
words.en: The process of growth, progress, or advancement towards achieving a better state or condition in the future.

words.ex: Please refrain from interrupting while I am speaking.
words.ex_cn: 请在我说话时不要打断。
words.en: To deliberately avoid speaking or acting in a way that breaks someone else's concentration or speech.

words.ex: The small restaurant is a family-run organization.
words.ex_cn: 这家小餐馆是一家家族经营的组织。

words.ex: He competes with his brother for the best grades.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟竞争最好的成绩。
words.en: If one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or services rather than those of the other company or country.

words.ex: The store offers special discounts on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在周末提供特别折扣。

words.ex: The shop gives discounts to returning customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店给回头客提供折扣。
words.en: People who buy from a business again.

words.ex: The company grew its client base last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年扩大了客户群。
words.en: The group of customers or clients that a business regularly serves.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车加油站；“petrol station”的复数
words.ex: He stops at petrol stations to fill his car.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A place where petrol is sold, typically also offering other services such as car washing and minor repairs.

words.tr: phrase. 市场交易额；市场份额；市场占有率
words.ex: The company increased its market share by lowering prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过降价增加了市场交易额。
words.en: The proportion of industry sales of a particular product or service that is controlled by a company.

words.tr: phrase. 经营中的场所；正在运营的机构
words.ex: These running establishments include cafes and small shops.
words.ex_cn: 这些经营中的场所包括咖啡馆和小商店。

words.ex: The company's sales income increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售收入增加了。

words.tr: phrase. 整理数据；汇集并排序数据
words.ex: He collates data from different surveys.
words.ex_cn: 他整理来自不同调查的数据。

words.ex: The company closed the unprofitable stations and kept only the profitable ones.
words.ex_cn: 公司关闭了不赚钱的车站，只保留了有利可图的车站。

words.tr: phrase. 清晰的视野；清楚的视线
words.ex: From the top of the mountain, we had a clear view of the valley below.
words.ex_cn: 从山顶上，我们可以清晰地看到下面的山谷。
words.en: A clear view refers to an unobstructed and distinct sight of something.

words.tr: phrase. 公司的财务状况；公司的资金运作
words.ex: The finances of the company are very strong this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的财务状况今年非常好。

words.ex: The company hired professional consultants to improve its operations.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了专业顾问来改进其运营。

words.tr: phrase. 便利店；方便商店（指营业时间长、商品种类有限但便于快速购买日常用品的小型零售店）
words.ex: He buys snacks at convenience stores after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后在便利店买零食。
words.en: Small retail shops located in residential areas, typically open long hours and selling everyday items.

words.tr: phrase. 财政负担；金钱上的消耗；经济上的损耗
words.ex: The continuous maintenance of the old building has become a significant financial drain for the company.
words.ex_cn: n. 持续维护旧建筑已成为公司的一大财务负担。
words.en: A financial drain refers to a situation where money is continuously being spent or lost, often causing a significant burden on one's finances.

words.tr: phrase. 履行他们的新职责
words.ex: The employees will carry out their new roles next month.
words.ex_cn: 这些员工下个月将履行他们的新职责。

words.ex: The company conquered the petrol market in just five years.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司五年内征服了石油市场。

words.tr: phrase. 扩展到（新领域）；涉足（新行业或活动）
words.ex: He decided to branch out into music after working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在当老师之后决定涉足音乐领域。
words.en: To expand or diversify into a new area of activity or business.

words.tr: phrase. 利润前景；盈利潜力
words.ex: The new market has good prospects for profits.
words.ex_cn: 这个新市场有良好的利润前景。

words.ex: The company built an environmentally-friendly brand image by using recycled materials.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过使用回收材料建立了环保的品牌形象。

words.tr: phrase. 拓宽范围；扩大视野或适用范围
words.ex: He reads more books to broaden the scope of his knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 他多读书来扩展自己的知识面。
words.en: To expand the range or extent of something, making it more inclusive or covering more areas.

words.ex: The company plans to strengthen its relationships with local suppliers.
words.ex_cn: 该公司计划加强与本地供应商的关系。

words.tr: phrase. 当地社区；本地社群
words.ex: The festival is a great opportunity for local communities to come together.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是当地社区聚在一起的好机会。
words.en: Local communities refer to groups of people living in the same area who share common interests, values, and concerns.

words.ex: The company focuses on development and improvement of its products.
words.ex_cn: 公司专注于产品的开发和改进。
words.en: The process of growth and enhancement.

words.ex: The evolution of the company took ten years.
words.ex_cn: 公司的发展演变花了十年时间。

words.tr: phrase. 销售人员；销售团队；营业人员
words.ex: The sales staff is trained to handle customer inquiries efficiently.
words.ex_cn: 销售人员经过培训，能够高效处理客户咨询。
words.en: The group of employees responsible for selling products or services.

words.tr: n. 首席执行官（Chief Executive Officers 的缩写）；公司最高管理者
words.ex: The CEOs meet every Monday to discuss the company's future.
words.ex_cn: 首席执行官们每周一开会讨论公司未来。
words.en: An abbreviation for 'Chief Executive Officers', the plural form of CEO.

words.tr: phrase. 员工讨论；职员间的讨论
words.ex: The staff discussions helped improve the work plan.
words.ex_cn: 员工讨论帮助改进了工作计划。

words.ex: His ideas and concerns helped improve the project.
words.ex_cn: 他的想法和担忧帮助改进了这个项目。

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.tr: phrase. 适应个体差异；包容个人独特性
words.ex: The teacher tries to accommodate the individuality of each student.
words.ex_cn: 老师努力适应每个学生的个体差异。

words.tr: phrase. 至关重要的公司身份；主导性的企业认同
words.ex: The overriding company identity is customer trust.
words.ex_cn: 至关重要的公司身份是客户信任。

words.tr: phrase. 赢利策略；盈利策略
words.ex: The company uses simple profit-making strategies to increase sales.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用简单的赢利策略来增加销售额。

words.tr: phrase. 商业上成功的；在市场或盈利方面取得成功的
words.ex: The movie was commercially successful and made a lot of money.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影商业上很成功，赚了很多钱。
words.en: Achieving financial success or profitability in the market.

words.ex: The company improved staff satisfaction by giving better benefits.
words.ex_cn: 公司通过提供更好的福利提高了员工满意度。

words.ex: The manager will familiarize the staff with the new software.
words.ex_cn: 经理将使员工熟悉新软件。

words.ex: The government has introduced new regulations to improve air quality.
words.ex_cn: 政府引入了新规定以改善空气质量。
words.en: New regulations refer to recently established rules or laws designed to control or govern conduct.

words.tr: 动词短语 结束讲座
words.ex: The professor will conclude the lecture at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 教授将在下午5点结束讲座。

words.tr: phrase. 值得深思的想法或信息；引人思考的内容
words.ex: His speech gave us food for thought.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲让我们深思。
words.en: If something is described as providing food for thought, it is worth thinking about or considering seriously.

words.ex: He keeps maintaining open-mindedness when he hears new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到新想法时，他一直保持开放的心态。

words.tr: phrase. 扩张策略；扩展策略
words.ex: The company developed new strategies for expansion into Asian markets.
words.ex_cn: 该公司制定了进入亚洲市场的新扩张策略。

words.ex: He works as an independent consultant for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 他为小企业担任独立顾问。

words.tr: phrase. 客观且无偏见的观点
words.ex: The journalist gave an objective and unbiased view of the event.
words.ex_cn: 记者对这一事件给出了客观且无偏见的观点。

words.tr: phrase. 使你的能力模糊；妨碍你的能力
words.ex: Stress can cloud your ability to think clearly.
words.ex_cn: 压力会妨碍你清晰思考的能力。
words.en: To impair or obscure one's capacity to think, judge, or perceive clearly, often due to emotion or distraction.

words.tr: phrase. 做与业务相关的决策
words.ex: The manager makes business-related decisions every day.
words.ex_cn: 经理每天做与业务相关的决策。

words.ex: The teacher chose suitable case studies for the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师为学生选择了适当的案例研究。

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；大型零售商店，内部分为多个商品部门
words.ex: She buys clothes at department stores.
words.ex_cn: 她去百货商店买衣服。
words.en: A department store is a large shop which is divided into several departments, each selling a different type of goods.

words.tr: phrase. 改变他们的组织结构
words.ex: The company decided to alter their organizational structure to improve efficiency.
