words.ex_cn: 公司决定改变他们的组织结构以提高效率。

words.ex: The company is minimizing costs to make more profit.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在降低成本以获得更多利润。
words.en: Reducing expenses to the lowest possible amount.

words.tr: phrase. 员工冗余；人员裁减
words.ex: The company announced staff redundancies to cut costs.
words.ex_cn: 公司宣布了员工冗余以降低成本。

words.ex: The court follows past precedents to make decisions.
words.ex_cn: 法院遵循过去的先例来做出判决。
words.en: Precedents are past actions or decisions that are used as examples or rules to be followed in similar situations later.

words.ex: He undervalues his own talent.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了自己的才华。
words.en: If you undervalue something or someone, you fail to recognize how valuable or important they are.

words.ex: She wraps up the gift with colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸把礼物包起来。

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The Industrial Revolution was a new epoch in history.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命是历史上一个新时代。
words.en: An epoch is a period of time in history or a person's life, typically one marked by notable events or particular characteristics.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.ex: The ruins show the antiquity of this civilization.
words.ex_cn: 这些废墟展示了这个文明的古老。
words.en: The ancient past, especially the period before the Middle Ages.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.tr: phrase. 中世纪（约公元500年至1500年的欧洲历史时期）
words.ex: People lived in small villages during the middle ages.
words.ex_cn: 在中世纪，人们住在小村庄里。
words.en: The Middle Ages is the period in European history from the fall of the Roman Empire in the West (5th century) to the fall of Constantinople (15th century), or, more narrowly, from about 1000 to 1453.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.ex: The old house has a colonial style.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子具有殖民地风格。
words.en: Colonial means relating to a system or period of colonization, or to the people who live in a colony.

words.ex: The imperial palace was built long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这座帝国宫殿是很久以前建造的。
words.en: relating to an empire or an emperor; majestic or superior in quality or size

words.ex: The industrial revolution changed how people made things.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命改变了人们制造东西的方式。
words.en: The Industrial Revolution was the transition to new manufacturing processes in the period from about 1760 to sometime between 1820 and 1840.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: The old temple is a relic from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙是来自古代的遗迹。
words.en: An object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest.

words.tr:
v. 剩下；留下；依然不变；
n. 遗迹；残余；遗体；
words.ex: Only two cookies remains on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上只剩下两块饼干了。
words.en: The parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；废墟；“ruin”的复数； v. 毁灭；破坏；
words.ex: The war left the city in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 战争使这座城市化为废墟。
words.en: The remains of a building, city, etc., that has been destroyed or is in a state of decay.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: They will reconstruct the old bridge next year.
words.ex_cn: 他们明年将重建这座旧桥。
words.en: If you reconstruct something that has been destroyed or badly damaged, you build it and make it work again.

words.ex: He improved his dating technique by reading books on relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他通过阅读关于人际关系的书籍来提高他的约会技巧。
words.en: A method or strategy used to make romantic or social engagements more successful.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.tr: n. 神话；神话学；神话集；
words.ex: He loves reading Greek mythology.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读希腊神话。
words.en: Mythology is a collection of myths, especially one belonging to a particular religious or cultural tradition.

words.tr: n. 民间传说；民俗学；民间风俗；
words.ex: The old man told us a folklore about a dragon living in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 老人给我们讲了一个关于住在山里的龙的民间传说。
words.en: Folklore is the traditional stories, customs, and habits of a particular community or nation.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.ex: His legacy includes many charity schools.
words.ex_cn: 他的遗产包括许多慈善学校。
words.en: Something handed down from an ancestor or a predecessor or from the past.

words.ex: He inherited his ancestral land from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里继承了祖传的土地。
words.en: Something that is ancestral relates to ancestors or to something that has been passed down from ancestors.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: It is a taboo to speak his name in this village.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村子里，提到他的名字是禁忌。
words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 文化认同；文化身份；文化特性
words.ex: He is proud of his cultural identity.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的文化身份感到自豪。
words.en: Cultural identity is the identity or feeling of belonging to a group. It is part of a person's self-conception and self-perception and is related to nationality, ethnicity, religion, social class, generation, locality or any kind of social group that has its own distinct culture.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度迅速下降。
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.tr: v. 彻底变革；使革命化；
words.ex: The new technology will revolutionize how we learn.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将彻底变革我们的学习方式。
words.en: To completely change something, especially in a way that improves it.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: The smell of perfume shows diffusion in the air.
words.ex_cn: 香水的气味展示了在空气中的扩散。
words.en: Diffusion is the process by which a new idea or product spreads through a population.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.ex: He tries to assimilate new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力吸收新单词。
words.en: To assimilate means to take in and understand fully ideas, information, or culture, or to make something become part of a group or system.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: The revival of traditional music brought joy to many people.
words.ex_cn: 传统音乐的复兴给许多人带来了快乐。
words.en: The process of something becoming popular or active again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.ex: The country still has a monarchy with a king as the head of state.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家仍然实行君主制，国王是国家元首。
words.en: A monarchy is a form of government in which a country is ruled by a monarch, such as a king or queen.

words.tr: n. 贵族政治；贵族统治；贵族
words.ex: The aristocracy lived in big castles long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，贵族住在巨大的城堡里。
words.en: The highest class in certain societies, especially those holding hereditary titles or offices.

words.ex: The peasant worked in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民每天早上都在田里劳作。
words.en: A peasant is a poor person of low social status who works on the land; used of people who live in countries where farming is still a common way of life.

words.ex: The serfs toiled in the fields from dawn until dusk.
words.ex_cn: 农奴从早到晚在田里辛勤劳作。
words.en: A serf is a person in a condition of servitude, required to render services to a lord, commonly attached to the lord's land and transferred with it from one owner to another.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: The empire ruled many countries long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国很久以前统治了许多国家。
words.en: An empire is a group of countries or territories that are under the control of a single ruler or government.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.tr: n. 木乃伊（mummy 的复数形式）
words.ex: The museum has ancient mummies from Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有来自埃及的古代木乃伊。
words.en: Preserved bodies of ancient Egyptian dead.

words.ex: The pharaoh built a big pyramid.
words.ex_cn: 法老建造了一座巨大的金字塔。
words.en: A pharaoh was a king in ancient Egypt, considered a god as well as a political leader.

words.tr: n. 象形字（如古埃及等所用的）( hieroglyph的名词复数 ); 秘密的或另有含意的书写符号
words.ex: Ancient Egyptians wrote in hieroglyphs.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人用象形文字书写。
words.en: Ancient Egyptian writing system using pictorial symbols, often carved on monuments.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.tr: n. 城邦（复数）；指拥有独立主权的城市国家
words.ex: Ancient Greece had many city-states.
words.ex_cn: 古希腊有许多城邦。
words.en: Independent cities that also function as states.

words.ex: People vote in democracy to choose their leaders.
words.ex_cn: 人们在民主制度下投票选择他们的领导人。
words.en: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr: n. 神话；神话学；神话集；
words.ex: He loves reading Greek mythology.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读希腊神话。
words.en: Mythology is a collection of myths, especially one belonging to a particular religious or cultural tradition.

words.ex: He watches the olympics every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: The Olympics are an international sports festival that originated in ancient Greece and includes summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.tr: phrase. 罗马法；古罗马的法律体系
words.ex: Roman law influenced many modern legal systems.
words.ex_cn: 罗马法影响了许多现代法律体系。

words.tr: phrase. 森林城市；指被丛林包围或位于丛林中的城市
words.ex: The jungle cities were hidden deep in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 这些森林城市隐藏在雨林深处。

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: The ancient stones had strange glyphs carved on them.
words.ex_cn: 这些古老的石头上刻着奇怪的图形符号。
words.en: Symbols or characters used in writing systems, especially ancient ones.

words.tr: phrase. 四大发明（指中国古代的造纸术、印刷术、火药和指南针）
words.ex: The Four Great Inventions of ancient China are papermaking, gunpowder, printing, and the compass.
words.ex_cn: 中国古代的四大发明是造纸术、火药、印刷术和指南针。
words.en: The four great inventions refer to papermaking, printing, the compass, and gunpowder, which are significant contributions to the world from ancient China.

words.ex: He believes in Confucianism and respects his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他信奉儒家思想，并尊重父母。
words.en: Confucianism is a system of philosophical and ethical teachings founded by Confucius and developed by his followers.

words.ex: Merchants traveled the silk road to trade goods.
words.ex_cn: 商人沿着丝绸之路贸易商品。
words.en: The Silk Road refers to the ancient network of trade routes that connected the East and West, facilitating the exchange of goods, culture, and ideas.

words.ex: The imperial examination was a rigorous process to select officials in ancient China.
words.ex_cn: 科举考试是中国古代选拔官员的严格过程。
words.en: The imperial examination was a civil service examination system in Imperial China designed to select the best administrative officials for the state's bureaucracy.

words.tr: phrase. 商品交易所；买卖大宗商品的市场
words.ex: He trades oil on the commodity exchange.
words.ex_cn: 他在商品交易所交易石油。
words.en: A regulated market where standardized commodities like grains, metals, or energy are traded.

words.ex: The university is actively involved in technology transfer to promote innovation in the local industry.
words.ex_cn: 该大学积极从事技术转移，以促进当地产业的创新。
words.en: The process of transferring skills, knowledge, technologies, methods of manufacturing, samples of manufacturing and facilities among governments or universities and other institutions to ensure that scientific and technological developments are accessible to a wider range of users who can then further develop and exploit the technology into new products, processes, applications, materials or services.

words.ex: He practices Buddhism every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上修行佛教。
words.en: Buddhism is a religion and philosophy based on the teachings of the Buddha, emphasizing the elimination of suffering and the attainment of enlightenment.

words.tr: phrase. 大航海时代；地理大发现时代
words.ex: During the age of discovery, explorers sailed to new lands.
words.ex_cn: 在大航海时代，探险家们航行到新的土地。

words.ex: Modern ships use advanced navigation technology to find their way.
words.ex_cn: 现代船舶使用先进的导航技术来确定航向。

words.ex: The country's colonial expansion began in the 1500s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的殖民扩张始于16世纪。

words.tr: phrase. 哥伦布大交换（指1492年哥伦布到达美洲后，旧大陆与新大陆之间在动植物、疾病、文化、人口等方面的广泛交流）
words.ex: The Columbian exchange brought potatoes from America to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 哥伦布大交换将马铃薯从美洲带到欧洲。

words.ex: He dreamed of finding a new world.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想发现一个新世界。

words.ex: The farm used mechanization to plant crops faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场使用机械化来更快地种植庄稼。
words.en: The process of changing a process or industry so that machines are used instead of people or animals to do the work.

words.ex: The city is facing problems because of rapid urbanization.
words.ex_cn: 由于快速的城市化，这座城市正面临问题。
words.en: The process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.

words.tr: phrase. 工人阶级；劳动阶层
words.ex: His parents are working class people.
words.ex_cn: 他的父母是工人阶级的人。
words.en: The working class consists of people who are employed for wages, especially in manual or industrial work.

words.ex: The steam engine moved the train on old tracks.
words.ex_cn: 蒸汽机车在旧轨道上行驶。
words.en: A steam engine is a heat engine that performs mechanical work using steam as its working fluid.

words.tr: n. 人道主义； 人文主义
words.ex: He believes in humanism and values people over rules.
words.ex_cn: 他相信人文主义，重视人而非规则。
words.en: Humanism is a philosophical stance that emphasizes the value and agency of human beings, individually and collectively, and generally prefers critical thinking and evidence (rationalism, empiricism) over acceptance of dogma or superstition.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术复兴；艺术领域的重新兴起
words.ex: The artistic revival in Italy brought back painting and sculpture.
words.ex_cn: 意大利的艺术复兴重新带来了绘画和雕塑。

words.tr: phrase. 科学革命；指16至17世纪期间，欧洲在天文学、物理学、生物学等领域发生根本性变革，奠定现代科学基础的历史时期
words.ex: The scientific revolution changed how people understood nature.
words.ex_cn: 科学革命改变了人们理解自然的方式。
words.en: The scientific revolution refers to the series of events in the 16th and 17th centuries that marked the emergence of modern science, characterized by significant changes in the way people understood and studied the natural world.

words.ex: He values individualism in his work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中重视个人主义。
words.en: Individualism is the belief that the rights and freedom of the individual are the most important rights in a society.

words.ex: The rise and fall of empires is a common topic in history.
words.ex_cn: 帝国的兴衰是历史中的一个常见话题。
words.en: The phrase 'rise and fall' refers to the process of increasing and then decreasing in power, status, or importance.

words.ex: The country enjoys prosperity after years of peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在多年的和平后迎来了繁荣。
words.en: Prosperity is a condition in which a person, community, or country is thriving and successful, especially in financial terms.

words.tr: n. （对资源等的）过度开采，（对工人等的）过度剥削
words.ex: The overexploitation of natural resources has led to environmental degradation.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的过度开采导致了环境退化。
words.en: The excessive use of natural resources beyond their capacity to regenerate, leading to environmental degradation and loss of biodiversity.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.tr: phrase. 社会动荡；社会不安定状态
words.ex: The protest caused social unrest in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这次抗议在城市中引发了社会动荡。
words.en: Social unrest refers to a state of dissatisfaction, disturbance, and agitation among a large number of people within a society, often leading to protests or riots.

words.tr: phrase. 文化的传播；文化扩散（指文化元素从一个社会或群体传播到另一个社会或群体的过程）
words.ex: Cultural diffusion has led to a blending of traditions across the globe.
words.ex_cn: 文化扩散导致了全球传统习俗的融合。
words.en: Cultural diffusion refers to the spread of cultural beliefs and social activities from one group to another.

words.ex: The immigrants quickly learned the language and culture, showing rapid assimilation.
words.ex_cn: 这些移民很快学会了语言和文化，显示出快速的同化。
words.en: The process of taking in and fully understanding information or ideas.

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.tr: phrase. 混合文化；不同文化元素融合形成的文化形态
words.ex: The city has a hybrid culture from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市拥有来自许多国家的混合文化。

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.ex: He knows the social hierarchy in his school.
words.ex_cn: 他了解学校里的社会等级。
words.en: A system in which members of a society are ranked according to relative status or authority.

words.tr: phrase. 范式转移；思维模式的根本转变
words.ex: The internet caused a paradigm shift in how people communicate.
words.ex_cn: 互联网引发了人们交流方式的根本性转变。
words.en: A paradigm shift is a fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions.

words.tr: phrase. 传统的看法；普遍接受的观点
words.ex: The conventional view on this matter is often challenged by new research.
words.ex_cn: 关于这个问题的传统观点经常被新的研究挑战。
words.en: A conventional view is a perspective or opinion that is widely accepted or traditional.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: The police found new evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场发现了新证据。

words.ex: He tries to reinterpret the old rule.
words.ex_cn: 他试图重新解释这条旧规则。
words.en: To interpret something in a new or different way.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.tr: n. 采伐森林；森林开伐；
words.ex: Deforestation is killing many animals.
words.ex_cn: 采伐森林正在杀死许多动物。
words.en: The act of cutting down or burning all the trees in an area.

words.ex: Heavy rain causes soil erosion on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致山坡上的土壤侵蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The company failed because of overexpansion.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司因过度膨胀而倒闭。

words.tr: phrase. 经济负担；指个人、家庭、组织或社会在经济上承受的压力或成本
words.ex: The disease caused a heavy economic burden on the family.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病给这个家庭带来了沉重的经济负担。
words.en: An economic burden refers to the financial strain or load that is placed on an individual, family, or organization due to various economic factors such as taxes, healthcare costs, or other financial obligations.

words.ex: The government punished the official for corruption.
words.ex_cn: 政府因贪污惩罚了那名官员。
words.en: Corruption is dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in positions of power.

words.tr: phrase. 内部腐烂；内部衰退
words.ex: The fruit showed signs of internal decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果显示出内部腐烂的迹象。

words.ex: Fast population growth leads to resource depletion.
words.ex_cn: 人口快速增长导致资源耗竭。
words.en: The reduction in the quantity or quality of resources available, often due to overuse or exploitation.

words.tr: phrase. 生态崩溃；生态系统因环境破坏或资源枯竭而发生的急剧恶化或瓦解
words.ex: The forest suffered an ecological collapse after the fires.
words.ex_cn: 森林在火灾后经历了生态崩溃。
words.en: A severe breakdown in the functioning of an ecosystem, leading to a loss of its essential structure and processes.

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.ex: The village built a new water management system to save rainwater.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄建了一个新的水资源管理系统来储存雨水。

words.tr: phrase. 季风变异性；季风变化的不稳定性
words.ex: Climate scientists study monsoon variability to predict rainfall changes.
words.ex_cn: 气候科学家研究季风变异性以预测降雨变化。

words.tr: phrase. 城市废弃；城市地区被遗弃的现象
words.ex: The old factory area shows signs of urban abandonment.
words.ex_cn: 旧工厂区域显示出城市废弃的迹象。

words.tr: phrase. 维护失败；保养失效
words.ex: The machine stopped because of maintenance failure.
words.ex_cn: 机器停止是因为维护失败。

words.tr: phrase. 跨文化交流；不同文化之间的互动与信息交换
words.ex: Students join cross-cultural exchange to learn about other countries.
words.ex_cn: 学生参加跨文化交流以了解其他国家。
words.en: The sharing and interaction of ideas, values, and practices between different cultures.

words.tr: phrase. 国际大都市；多元文化的城市
words.ex: Tokyo and New York are cosmopolitan cities with people from all over the world.
words.ex_cn: 东京和纽约是来自世界各地人们汇聚的国际大都市。

words.tr: phrase. 知识的保存；知识的保护
words.ex: Libraries help in the preservation of knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有助于知识的保存。

words.tr: phrase. 翻译运动；指某一时期或地区内系统性地将文本从一种语言翻译成另一种语言的文化或学术活动
words.ex: The translation movement helped spread knowledge in the Middle Ages.
words.ex_cn: 翻译运动在中世纪帮助传播了知识。

words.ex: The scientific advancement in medicine has led to the development of new treatments.
words.ex_cn: 医学上的科学进步导致了新疗法的开发。
words.en: The development and improvement of scientific knowledge and technology.

words.ex: Gunpowder was used to make fireworks.
words.ex_cn: 火药被用来制作烟花。
words.en: A black or brown explosive substance consisting of a mixture of potassium nitrate, charcoal, and sulfur, used in gunnery and as a blasting agent in mining.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.tr: phrase. 蒙古治世（指13至14世纪蒙古帝国统治期间欧亚大陆的和平与稳定）
words.ex: During the Pax Mongolica, traders could travel safely from China to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 在蒙古治世期间，商人可以安全地从中国旅行到欧洲。

words.ex: The pirates destroyed the safe trade routes along the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海盗摧毁了沿海的安全贸易路线。

words.tr: phrase. 行政系统；管理体系
words.ex: The school has a simple administrative system.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个简单的行政系统。

words.tr: phrase. 生产率激增；生产力大幅提高
words.ex: The new technology caused a productivity boom in the factory.
words.ex_cn: 新技术使工厂出现了生产率激增。

words.ex: The river is dirty because of environmental pollution.
words.ex_cn: 由于环境污染，这条河变得很脏。
words.en: Environmental pollution refers to the contamination of the physical and biological components of the earth/atmosphere system to such an extent that normal environmental processes are adversely affected.

words.tr: phrase. 全球不平等；世界各国之间或全球范围内在财富、资源、机会等方面的不平等现象
words.ex: Global inequality is growing between rich and poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 富裕国家和贫穷国家之间的全球不平等正在加剧。

words.tr: phrase. 知识的民主化；使知识为大众所共享和获取的过程
words.ex: The internet helps the democratization of knowledge by letting everyone learn for free.
words.ex_cn: 互联网通过让每个人免费学习，促进了知识的民主化。

words.ex: The reformation improved the school's teaching methods.
words.ex_cn: 这场革新改善了学校的教学方法。
words.en: The act or process of improving or changing something, especially a system or organization, in order to make it more effective or appropriate.

words.tr: phrase. 方言；土语；本地语言（指非正式的、地区性的口语表达方式）
words.ex: He speaks his vernacular languages at home with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他在家和家人说方言。

words.tr: phrase. 大众识字；普及识字
words.ex: The government promoted mass literacy through free primary schools.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过免费小学推动大众识字。

words.tr: phrase. 选择性现代化；有选择地进行现代化改造
words.ex: The country pursued selective modernization by upgrading only key industries.
words.ex_cn: 该国通过仅升级关键产业来实行选择性现代化。

words.ex: The country's industrialization began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: The process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.tr: phrase. 政治改革；政治体制改革
words.ex: The country needs political reform to improve democracy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家需要政治改革来改善民主。
words.en: Political reform refers to the process of changing political institutions, practices, or policies, often with the aim of improving governance, increasing democracy, or addressing systemic issues.

words.ex: The oversimplification of complex issues can lead to misunderstandings.
words.ex_cn: 对复杂问题的过度简化可能导致误解。
words.en: An oversimplification is a description or explanation of something that makes it seem much simpler than it really is, often leading to a misunderstanding of the facts.

words.ex: The university encourages an interdisciplinary approach to research.
words.ex_cn: 该大学鼓励跨学科的研究方法。
words.en: An interdisciplinary approach involves combining methods and insights from two or more disciplines to address complex issues.

words.tr: phrase. 口述历史；口述史学；通过录音访谈等方式收集的个人亲历叙述
words.ex: He recorded oral history from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里记录了口述历史。
words.en: Oral history is the collection and study of historical information using tape recordings, videotapes, or transcriptions of planned interviews. These interviews are conducted with people who participated in or observed past events and whose memories and perceptions of these are to be preserved as an aural record for future generations.

words.tr: phrase. 替代视角；不同的看法
words.ex: He offered an alternative perspective on the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了对这个问题的替代视角。

words.ex: The government helps marginalized groups get better education.
words.ex_cn: 政府帮助被边缘化的群体获得更好的教育。

words.tr: phrase. 迁徙模式；动物或人群季节性迁移的规律
words.ex: Birds follow migratory patterns every season.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类每年都会遵循它们的迁徙模式。

words.tr: phrase. 捕食性行为；掠夺性行为
words.ex: The lion's predatory behavior helps it catch prey.
words.ex_cn: 狮子的捕食性行为帮助它捕捉猎物。

words.ex: He knows the social hierarchy in his school.
words.ex_cn: 他了解学校里的社会等级。
words.en: A system in which members of a society are ranked according to relative status or authority.

words.ex: Birds use different foraging strategies to find food.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类使用不同的觅食策略来寻找食物。

words.ex: Dogs show territorial instinct by barking at strangers near their home.
words.ex_cn: 狗通过在自家附近对陌生人吠叫来表现领地本能。

words.tr: phrase. 认知能力；指个体感知、记忆、思维、判断和解决问题等心理过程的能力
words.ex: Children develop cognitive abilities as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive abilities refer to the mental skills that we use to perform any task, from the simplest to the most complex. They are linked with the mechanisms of how we learn, remember, problem-solve, and pay attention.

words.ex: Tool use is common among primates like chimpanzees.
words.ex_cn: 工具使用在黑猩猩等灵长类动物中很常见。

words.ex: The phone is part of a communication system.
words.ex_cn: 电话是通信系统的一部分。
words.en: A communication system is a collection of individual telecommunications networks, transmission systems, relay stations, tributary stations, and data terminal equipment usually capable of interconnection and interoperation to form an integrated whole.

words.tr: phrase. 父母照顾；亲代抚育
words.ex: Birds show parental care by feeding their babies.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类通过喂养幼鸟来表现亲代照顾。
words.en: The nurturing and protection provided by parents to their offspring.

words.ex: Bears follow a hibernation cycle every winter.
words.ex_cn: 熊每年冬天都会经历一个冬眠周期。

words.tr: phrase. 进化适应；生物通过自然选择逐渐形成的适应环境的特征
words.ex: The polar bear's thick fur is an evolutionary adaptation to cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊厚厚的毛发是对寒冷天气的进化适应。

words.tr: phrase. 自然选择；物竞天择
words.ex: Birds with strong beaks survive by natural selection.
words.ex_cn: 喙强的鸟通过自然选择生存下来。
words.en: The process by which forms of life having traits that better enable them to adapt to specific environmental pressures, as predators, changes in climate, or competition for food or mates, will tend to survive and reproduce in greater numbers than others of their kind, thus ensuring the perpetuation of those favorable traits in succeeding generations.

words.tr: phrase. 物种形成过程；生物通过进化产生新物种的过程
words.ex: The speciation process takes many generations.
words.ex_cn: 物种形成过程需要许多代的时间。

words.tr: phrase. 趋同进化；不同物种在相似环境压力下独立演化出相似特征的现象
words.ex: Birds and bats have wings, which is an example of convergent evolution.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类和蝙蝠都有翅膀，这是趋同进化的一个例子。
words.en: The process by which unrelated species develop similar traits due to similar environmental pressures.

words.tr: phrase. 适应性辐射；指一个祖先物种在不同环境中演化出多种形态和生态位以适应不同生存条件的现象
words.ex: Darwin's finches show adaptive radiation in the Galapagos Islands.
words.ex_cn: 达尔文雀在加拉帕戈斯群岛上展示了适应性辐射。

words.tr: phrase. 生存机制；生物为维持生命而采取的适应性策略
words.ex: Cacti have a survival mechanism to store water in dry places.
words.ex_cn: 仙人掌有一种在干旱环境中储存水分的生存机制。

words.tr: phrase. 生态位；环境中的特定角色或位置
words.ex: The bird's environmental niche is in the forest canopy.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟的生态位在森林树冠层。

words.tr: 名词短语. 遗传突变；基因发生永久性改变的现象，可能导致生物性状的变化
words.ex: The genetic mutation caused the plant to grow differently.
words.ex_cn: 这种基因突变使植物生长方式不同了。
words.en: A permanent alteration in the DNA sequence of an organism, which can be inherited or occur spontaneously.

words.tr: phrase. 选择压力；自然选择对生物性状施加的环境压力
words.ex: The selective pressure from predators made faster rabbits survive.
words.ex_cn: 捕食者的选择压力使跑得更快的兔子存活下来。

words.tr: phrase. 灭绝事件；指地球上大量物种在短时间内突然消失的地质事件
words.ex: A meteor impact caused a mass extinction event.
words.ex_cn: 一颗陨石撞击导致了一次大规模灭绝事件。

words.tr: phrase. 现场观察；实地观测
words.ex: The scientist did field observation in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在森林里进行了实地观察。
words.en: Field observation refers to the process of observing phenomena or behaviors in their natural setting, typically as part of a scientific study or research.

words.tr: phrase. 圈养繁殖；人工繁殖（指在人工控制环境下对动物进行繁殖以保护濒危物种）
words.ex: Captive breeding programs are essential for the survival of many endangered species.
words.ex_cn: 圈养繁殖计划对于许多濒危物种的生存至关重要。
words.en: The practice of breeding animals in controlled environments within well-defined settings, such as wildlife reserves, zoos, or other conservation facilities, to increase the population of endangered species.

words.ex: Scientists use radio telemetry to track the migration patterns of birds.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们使用无线电遥测技术来追踪鸟类的迁徙模式。
words.en: Radio telemetry is the process of using radio waves to transmit data from a remote source to a receiving station for monitoring and analysis.

words.tr: phrase. 脱氧核糖核酸分析；基因分析
words.ex: The lab does dna analysis to find clues.
words.ex_cn: 实验室做DNA分析来寻找线索。
words.en: The scientific study of an individual's genetic material to identify traits or relationships.

words.tr: phrase. 化石证据，指通过化石记录所提供的关于古代生物及其演化的科学证据
words.ex: The fossil evidence shows ancient animals lived here.
words.ex_cn: 化石证据表明古代动物曾生活在这里。
words.en: Physical remains or traces of ancient organisms used for scientific study.

words.tr: phrase. 行为生态学；研究生物行为与其生态环境之间关系的学科
words.ex: Behavioral ecology studies how animals behave in their natural environment.
words.ex_cn: 行为生态学研究动物在自然环境中的行为。

words.tr: phrase. 种群动态；人口动态（研究种群数量、结构及其随时间变化的规律）
words.ex: Scientists study population dynamics in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究森林中的种群动态。
words.en: The study of how the size, distribution, and composition of populations change over time and space.

words.tr: phrase. 保护努力；保育行动
words.ex: The conservation effort helped save the endangered birds.
words.ex_cn: 保护努力帮助拯救了濒危鸟类。
words.en: An action or initiative aimed at protecting and preserving natural resources, wildlife, and their habitats.

words.tr: phrase. 栖息地破碎化；指原本连续的自然栖息地被分割成小块且相互隔离的现象
words.ex: The road caused habitat fragmentation for the animals.
words.ex_cn: 这条路导致了动物栖息地的碎片化。
words.en: The process by which a large, continuous habitat is divided into smaller, isolated areas, often reducing biodiversity.

words.tr: phrase. 生物多样性热点地区；生物种类特别丰富且面临严重威胁的区域
words.ex: The Amazon rainforest is a biodiversity hotspot.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊雨林是一个生物多样性热点地区。

words.tr: phrase. 生理适应；生物体为适应环境而发生的生理功能上的调整
words.ex: Penguins have a physiological adaptation to survive in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅有一种生理适应能力，以在寒冷的水中生存。

words.tr: phrase. 感知；感觉知觉；通过感官对外界刺激的感知和理解
words.ex: The baby's sensory perception helps it recognize sounds and colors.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的感知帮助它识别声音和颜色。
words.en: The process by which the body receives and interprets information from the five senses (sight, hearing, touch, taste, smell) to understand the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 代谢率；新陈代谢速率
words.ex: His metabolic rate is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢率非常高。
words.en: The speed at which your body uses energy.

words.ex: The process of thermoregulation helps maintain a stable internal body temperature.
words.ex_cn: 温度调节过程有助于维持稳定的内部体温。
words.en: Thermoregulation refers to the process by which organisms maintain a stable internal body temperature, despite variations in external temperature.

words.tr: phrase. 运动方式；移动方法
words.ex: The locomotion method of a fish is swimming.
words.ex_cn: 鱼的运动方式是游泳。

words.tr: phrase. 繁殖策略；生物为提高繁殖成功率而采取的行为或生理机制
words.ex: Fish have different reproductive strategies to survive in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 鱼类有不同的繁殖策略以在野外生存。

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food in the body.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统在体内分解食物。
words.en: The group of organs that break down food into smaller components that can be absorbed into the bloodstream and used by the body.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吸效率；肺部气体交换的效率
words.ex: Athletes train to improve their respiratory efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 运动员训练以提高他们的呼吸效率。

words.ex: The chameleon's camouflage ability helps it hide from predators.
words.ex_cn: 变色龙的伪装能力帮助它躲避捕食者。

words.ex: Smiling is a defensive mechanism to hide sadness.
words.ex_cn: 微笑是一种隐藏悲伤的防御机制。

words.tr: phrase. 小行星撞击；指小行星与地球或其他天体相撞的事件
words.ex: The dinosaur died from an asteroid impact.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙死于小行星撞击。
words.en: A collision between a celestial body, such as an asteroid or comet, and a planet, which can cause significant geological and climatic effects.

words.tr: phrase. 火山活动；指火山喷发、岩浆流动、火山灰释放等地质现象
words.ex: The volcanic activity on the island has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: n. 岛上的火山活动最近有所增加。
words.en: The phenomena associated with the eruption of magma from within the Earth's crust, including the emission of lava, gases, and ash.

words.ex: The geological layers show different types of rocks.
words.ex_cn: 地质层展示了不同类型的岩石。

words.tr: phrase. 化石记录（指保存在岩层中的古代生物遗骸或痕迹，用于研究地球历史和生物演化）
words.ex: Scientists study fossil records to learn about ancient animals.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究化石记录以了解古代动物。
words.en: The preserved remains or traces of ancient organisms found in rock layers, used to study Earth's history.

words.tr: phrase. 化学元素异常（指化学元素在含量或分布上偏离正常范围的现象）
words.ex: The soil showed chemical element anomalies, with too much iron and too little zinc.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中出现了化学元素异常，铁含量过高，锌含量过低。

words.tr: phrase. 选择性灭绝；指某些物种或特征因环境压力而被选择性地淘汰的现象
words.ex: The dinosaur extinction was a selective extinction that spared small mammals.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝是一种选择性灭绝，使小型哺乳动物幸存下来。

words.ex: The short-term effects of the medicine include dizziness and nausea.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物的短期效应包括头晕和恶心。

words.tr: phrase. 长期效应；长期影响；长期后果
words.ex: The medicine has long-term effects on children.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物对儿童有长期影响。
words.en: The consequences or impacts that occur over a long period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 铱异常（指地质层中铱元素异常富集的现象，常与小行星撞击事件相关）
words.ex: The iridium anomaly in the rock layer suggests a meteorite impact.
words.ex_cn: 岩层中的铱异常表明曾发生过陨石撞击。

words.tr: phrase. 震击石英（因陨石撞击等极端压力作用而产生特殊微观结构的石英）
words.ex: Scientists found shocked quartz in the rock layer from the asteroid impact.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在小行星撞击形成的岩层中发现了震击石英。

words.tr: n. 微球粒；微小的球状颗粒
words.ex: The rock contains tiny microspherules formed by volcanic eruptions.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石中含有由火山喷发形成的微小微球粒。

words.ex: Wildfires burned the forest last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，野火烧毁了森林。
words.en: A wildfire is an uncontrolled fire that burns in wildland vegetation, often in rural areas.

words.tr: n. 海啸( tsunami的名词复数 )
words.ex: The tsunamis caused widespread destruction along the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海啸给沿海地区造成了广泛的破坏。
words.en: Large, destructive ocean waves caused by underwater seismic activity or landslides.

words.tr: n. 地震；地震( earthquake的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Earthquakes can destroy buildings.
words.ex_cn: 地震会摧毁建筑物。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.ex: The volcanic ash layers buried the ancient city.
words.ex_cn: 火山灰层掩埋了这座古城。

words.ex: Acid rain kills trees and fish.
words.ex_cn: 酸雨杀死树木和鱼类。
words.en: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes environmental harm, typically to forests and lakes. The main cause is the industrial burning of coal and other fossil fuels, the waste gases from which contain sulfur and nitrogen oxides which combine with atmospheric water to form acids.

words.ex: The greenhouse effect makes the Earth warmer.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应使地球变暖。
words.en: The greenhouse effect is the process by which radiation from a planet's atmosphere warms the planet's surface to a temperature above what it would be without its atmosphere.

words.ex: The dust blocking sunlight made the sky look gray.
words.ex_cn: 阻挡阳光的尘埃让天空看起来灰蒙蒙的。

words.ex: The plant halted photosynthesis when it got dark.
words.ex_cn: 当天黑时，植物的光合作用停止了。

words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.ex: The food chain collapse killed many animals in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 食物链崩溃导致森林中许多动物死亡。

words.ex: He bought a small size shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一件小号衬衫。
words.en: A small size refers to something that is not large in physical dimensions.

words.tr: phrase. 杂食性饮食；既吃植物也吃动物的饮食方式
words.ex: Humans have an omnivorous diet, eating both plants and meat.
words.ex_cn: 人类是杂食性饮食，既吃植物也吃肉。

words.ex: The rabbit has a burrowing habit to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 兔子有挖洞的习性以保证安全。

words.ex: The rise of mammals happened after dinosaurs died out.
words.ex_cn: 哺乳动物的兴起发生在恐龙灭绝之后。

words.ex: Humans have internal clocks that tell them when to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 人类有内部时钟，告诉他们什么时候该睡觉。

words.tr: phrase. 昼夜节律；生理时钟（指生物体约24小时的自然生理周期）
words.ex: He follows his circadian rhythm to sleep at night.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循自己的昼夜节律在晚上睡觉。
words.en: A circadian rhythm is a natural, internal process that regulates the sleep-wake cycle and repeats roughly every 24 hours.

words.tr: phrase. 外部线索；外界提示
words.ex: The dog responded to external cues like hand signals.
words.ex_cn: 狗对像手势这样的外部线索做出了反应。

words.ex: Ancient sailors used star navigation methods to find their way.
words.ex_cn: 古代水手使用星象导航方法来寻找方向。

words.ex: Running increases your energy expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 跑步会增加你的能量消耗。

words.tr: phrase. 飞行策略；飞行方案
words.ex: Birds use different flight strategies to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类使用不同的飞行策略来节省能量。

words.tr: phrase. 推动力；驱动力；促使事物发展的主要因素
words.ex: Innovation and demand are the driving forces of the economy.
words.ex_cn: 创新和需求是经济的推动力。
words.en: The primary factors or motivations that cause something to happen or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 季节性的变化；随季节发生的变化
words.ex: The birds migrate because of seasonal changes.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类因为季节变化而迁徙。
words.en: Changes in weather and conditions that occur at different times of the year.

words.tr: phrase. 食物的可获得性；食物供应情况
words.ex: Food availability is low in the small village.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄的食物供应很少。
words.en: The state or condition in which food is obtainable or accessible.

words.tr: phrase. 繁殖需求；生物繁殖所需的条件或资源
words.ex: The reproduction needs of fish depend on water temperature.
words.ex_cn: 鱼类的繁殖需求取决于水温。

words.ex: This region has a suitable climate for growing oranges.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有适宜种植橙子的气候。

words.ex: The robot uses simple navigation mechanisms to avoid walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用简单的导航机制来避开墙壁。

words.tr: phrase. 太阳罗盘；利用太阳位置确定方向的仪器
words.ex: The explorer used a solar compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 探险家使用太阳罗盘来寻找北方。

words.tr: phrase. 星象导航；利用恒星位置进行导航的方法
words.ex: Ancient sailors used stellar navigation to find their way across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 古代水手用星象导航在海洋中寻找方向。

words.tr: phrase. 地磁感应；利用地球磁场进行检测或感知的技术
words.ex: The bird uses geomagnetic sensing to find its way during migration.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类利用地磁感应在迁徙时找到方向。

words.tr: phrase. 视觉地标；可识别的视觉标志
words.ex: He used visual landmarks to find his way home.
words.ex_cn: 他用视觉地标来找回家的路。

words.ex: Bears build up fat reserves before winter.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天来临前会储存脂肪。

words.tr: phrase. 编队飞行；以整齐队形飞行
words.ex: The birds were flying in formation across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿们在天空中编队飞行。

words.ex: He drag the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something along the ground, often with difficulty or effort.

words.tr: phrase. 中转地点；中途停留的站点
words.ex: Birds rest at stopover sites during their long migration.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在长途迁徙途中会在中转地点休息。

words.tr: phrase. 光污染（指人造光源对夜空环境造成的过度或不当照明，影响天文观测、生态系统和人类健康）
words.ex: The stars are hard to see because of light pollution.
words.ex_cn: 由于光污染，星星很难看到。
words.en: Excessive or misdirected artificial light that obscures the night sky.

words.tr: phrase. 栖息地丧失；生态环境被破坏导致生物无法生存的现象
words.ex: Animals lose their homes because of habitat loss.
words.ex_cn: 动物因为栖息地丧失而失去了家园。
words.en: The destruction or degradation of the natural environment in which a particular species lives, leading to a reduction in the available habitat and often resulting in a decline in population or extinction.

words.tr: phrase. 国际协定；国际协议；国际条约
words.ex: Countries make international agreements to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 各国制定国际协议以保护环境。
words.en: Formal treaties or pacts between nations to address global issues like climate or trade.

words.tr: phrase. 保护区；受保护区域
words.ex: The government sets up protected areas for wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 政府设立保护区来保护野生动物。
words.en: Protected areas are regions or zones of land or sea that are dedicated to the protection and maintenance of biological diversity, and of natural and associated cultural resources, and are managed through legal or other effective means.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.tr: phrase. 合租房屋；多人共同居住的住宅
words.ex: They live in a shared house with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他们和三个室友住在一个合租屋里。
words.en: A shared house is a living arrangement where two or more people live together in the same house, sharing common areas such as the kitchen and living room, but typically having private bedrooms.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.ex: He booked a single room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他预订了一个单人房间过夜。
words.en: A single room is a hotel room designed for one person, containing one single bed.

words.ex: We booked a double room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room intended for two people, typically containing a double bed.

words.tr: phrase. 标准间（酒店中配备基本设施的普通客房）
words.ex: They booked a standard room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他们为当晚预订了一间标准房。
words.en: A standard room typically refers to a basic hotel room that includes essential amenities such as a bed, a bathroom, and a small workspace, without the extra features or space found in more expensive room types.

words.tr: adj. 带有私人浴室的；套房的
words.ex: The room has an en-suite bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一个内嵌浴室。
words.en: An adjective describing a room or facility that is directly connected to and for the private use of a bedroom, especially in a hotel or house.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；“furnish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 配备家具的；
words.ex: They furnished the apartment with new tables and chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他们给公寓布置了新的桌椅。
words.en: If a room or building is furnished, it is equipped with furniture.

words.tr:
adj. 无装备的；无家具设备的
v. 搬走家具；“unfurnish”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The apartment is unfurnished.
words.ex_cn: 这个公寓没有家具。
words.en: If a room or house is unfurnished, it does not contain any furniture.

words.tr: adj. 自给的；（尤指学校等节假日期间）自供伙食的
words.ex: We stayed in a self-catering apartment.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在一个自助炊事的公寓里。
words.en: Self-catering refers to accommodation where guests are expected to provide and cook their own food, rather than having meals provided.

words.ex: Open your book to page 50.
words.ex_cn: 把你的书翻到第50页。

words.tr: phrase. 可用的设施；可用的设备
words.ex: The gym has facilities available for all students.
words.ex_cn: 健身房为所有学生提供设施。
words.en: Amenities or services that are accessible for use.

words.tr: phrase. 嵌入式厨房；定制厨房（指橱柜和电器等固定安装的厨房）
words.ex: The house has a fitted kitchen with built-in cabinets.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带嵌入式橱柜的嵌入式厨房。

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: The room has air conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: Air conditioning is a system or process that controls the temperature, humidity, and sometimes the purity of the air in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: The house has central heating for winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有中央供暖系统过冬。
words.en: A system that heats a building by sending hot water or steam through pipes to radiators in different rooms.

words.ex: He uses broadband to watch videos online.
words.ex_cn: 他使用宽带在线观看视频。
words.en: A type of high-speed Internet access that is always on and faster than the traditional dial-up access.

words.ex: He connects his phone to the wi-fi at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家把手机连接到无线网络。
words.en: Wi-Fi is a system for connecting electronic equipment to the internet without using wires, by using radio signals.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: There is no parking space near the store.
words.ex_cn: 商店附近没有停车位。
words.en: A parking space is a marked-out area where a vehicle can be parked.

words.ex: They swim in the swimming pool every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在游泳池里游泳。
words.en: A swimming pool is a large container filled with water, designed for people to swim in.

words.tr: phrase. 洗衣设施；洗衣设备
words.ex: The hotel has laundry facilities on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的二楼有洗衣设施。
words.en: Laundry facilities refer to the equipment and services provided for washing clothes, typically found in residential buildings, hotels, or public areas.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: He teaches math in a secondary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所中学教数学。
words.en: A secondary school is a school for pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 18.

words.tr: phrase. 大学校园；大学的校区
words.ex: The university campus is very beautiful in autumn.
words.ex_cn: n. 大学校园在秋天非常美丽。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.tr: 名词短语。教育资源，指用于支持教学和学习的各种材料、工具和设施，如教材、技术设备、图书馆和在线平台等。
words.ex: The school provides free education resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费的教育资源。
words.en: Materials and tools used for teaching and learning, like books or software.

words.ex: He takes public transport to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transport refers to the system of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.tr: 短语. 步行可达的范围内；步行距离内
words.ex: The supermarket is within walking distance of my house.
words.ex_cn: 超市离我家步行可达。
words.en: If something is within walking distance, it is close enough to be reached by walking.

words.tr: phrase. 购物中心；商业中心
words.ex: They went to the shopping centre to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们去购物中心买衣服。
words.en: A shopping centre is a group of shops and other commercial establishments built together on one site, often under one roof.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.ex: I buy milk from local shops every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上从本地商店买牛奶。
words.en: Local shops refer to small retail businesses that are owned and operated within a community, often providing goods and services tailored to the needs and preferences of the local population.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.tr: phrase. 娱乐设施；康乐设施；休闲设施
words.ex: The park offers various recreational facilities for visitors.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园为游客提供了各种各样的娱乐设施。
words.en: Recreational facilities are places, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for people to use in their free time for enjoyment.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: 短语. 费用包含在内（通常指房租或服务费中已包含水电费等账单）
words.ex: The rent is $500 and bills included.
words.ex_cn: 租金是500美元，水电费包含在内。
words.en: Indicates that the cost of utilities such as electricity, gas, and water is included in the rent or price.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 维护费；保养费；维修费用；管理费
words.ex: He pays a monthly maintenance fee for his apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付公寓的维护费。
words.en: A maintenance fee is a charge paid regularly to keep a property or service in good condition.

words.ex: He paid the agency fee to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了中介费来找工作。
words.en: A fee charged by an agency for its services, typically a percentage of the total transaction value.

words.ex: He paid the telephone fee for his monthly call plan.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了月度通话计划的电话费。

words.tr: phrase. 网络费用；互联网服务费
words.ex: He pays the internet fee every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付网络费用。
words.en: The cost charged for using an internet connection.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The hotel has a minimum stay of three nights.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的最低入住天数为三晚。

words.tr: phrase. 禁止携带宠物；不得饲养宠物
words.ex: There are no pets in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里不允许养宠物。
words.en: A rule or policy that prohibits the keeping of pets in a particular place.

words.ex: This is a non-smoking room.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个无烟房间。
words.en: Non-smoking refers to areas or policies where smoking is not allowed.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.ex: His date of birth is June 5, 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他的出生日期是2000年6月5日。
words.en: The day, month, and year on which someone was born.

words.ex: His nationality is Canadian.
words.ex_cn: 他的国籍是加拿大人。
words.en: Nationality is the legal relationship between an individual and a state, often used to refer to the country to which a person belongs.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: He wrote his postcode on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮编写在了信封上。
words.en: A postcode is a sequence of letters and numbers which is part of an address and shows exactly where a place is.

words.ex: He wrote his zip code on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮政编码写在了表格上。
words.en: A zip code is a system used in the United States to facilitate the delivery of mail. It consists of a five- or nine-digit code printed directly after the address, the first five digits (the initial code) indicating the state and post office or postal zone, the last four (the expanded code) the box section or number, portion of a rural route, building, or other specific delivery location.

words.ex: He gave me his telephone number.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我他的电话号码。
words.en: A telephone number is a sequence of digits assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks.

words.ex: He wrote his email address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的电子邮件地址写在了表格上。
words.en: An email address is a unique identifier for an email account. It is used to send and receive emails over the Internet.

words.tr: phrase. 当前地址；现居地址
words.ex: He wrote his current address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把现在的住址写在了表格上。
words.en: The place where someone is living or an organization is operating at the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 房产详情；物业详细信息
words.ex: The property details are listed on the website.
words.ex_cn: 房产详情列在网站上。
words.en: Specific information about a piece of real estate, such as its features and condition.

words.ex: The company has to pay significant rent fees for their downtown office.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须为市中心的办公室支付高昂的租金费用。
words.en: The amount of money that is paid regularly for the use of a property, especially as agreed in a contract.

words.tr: phrase. 联系方式；联系信息
words.ex: Please give me your contact info so I can call you.
words.ex_cn: 请给我你的联系方式，以便我联系你。

words.tr: prep. 包括；包含； v. 包括；包含；“include”的现在分词；
words.ex: The package includes apples, bananas, and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹包括苹果、香蕉和橙子。
words.en: You use including to introduce examples of people or things that are part of the group of people or things that you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 不包括；不计；把……除外
words.ex: The price is $50, exclusive of tax.
words.ex_cn: 价格是50美元，不含税。
words.en: Not including; excluding.

words.tr: phrase. 未被覆盖的；未被包括的；未受保护的
words.ex: The ground is not covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 地面没有被雪覆盖。

words.tr: phrase. 为…额外付费；为…支付附加费用
words.ex: He had to pay extra for faster shipping.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不为更快的快递多付钱。
words.en: To pay an additional amount beyond the standard price for something.

words.ex: He earns 200 dollars per week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周赚200美元。
words.en: Each week; weekly.

words.ex: He earns 500 dollars per month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月赚500美元。
words.en: used to indicate that something happens, is done, or is paid for each month

words.tr: phrase. 地理优势；区位优势
words.ex: The city's location advantage helps it attract more tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的地理优势有助于吸引更多的游客。

words.tr: phrase. 不允许的；被禁止的
words.ex: Smoking is not allowed here.
words.ex_cn: 这里不允许吸烟。
words.en: If something is not allowed, it is not permitted or authorized.

words.tr: v. 允许；允许( permit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher permitted us to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 老师允许我们早点离开。
words.en: Allowed or authorized, especially by an authority.

words.tr: phrase. 住宿类型；居住设施种类
words.ex: He chose a type of accommodation near the school.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一种靠近学校的住宿方式。
words.en: A category or kind of lodging or housing that is available for people to stay in, such as hotels, hostels, or rental apartments.

words.tr: phrase. 进行实验；实施试验
words.ex: The students conduct an experiment in science class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在科学课上做实验。
words.en: To carry out a scientific test or investigation to discover new facts or verify a hypothesis.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进行一项研究；实施一项调查
words.ex: The scientists will carry out a study on water quality.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们将进行一项关于水质的研究。
words.en: To conduct or perform a research project.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: 短语动词. 从……中汲取灵感；从……获得启发
words.ex: He draws inspiration from nature when he paints.
words.ex_cn: 他画画时从大自然中汲取灵感。
words.en: To derive ideas, motivation, or creativity from a source.

words.tr: phrase. 被仿效；以…为模型；模仿
words.ex: The new school is modeled on the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这所新学校是以旧学校为模式建立的。
words.en: To be based on or imitate the structure of something else.

words.tr: phrase. 检验一个假设；对某个假设进行测试
words.ex: He tests a hypothesis in his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学课上检验一个假设。
words.en: To conduct an experiment or investigation to confirm or disprove a theory.

words.ex: Scientists verify a hypothesis by running experiments.
words.ex_cn: 科学家通过实验来验证一个假设。

words.ex: He needs to substantiate his claim with evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他需要用证据来证实他的说法。
words.en: To substantiate a statement or a story means to supply evidence which proves that it is true.

words.ex: The experiment confirmed a theory about gravity.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验确认了一个关于引力的理论。

words.tr: phrase. 收集数据； gather 表示收集，data 指数据
words.ex: They gather data from the survey every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周从调查中收集数据。
words.en: To collect or accumulate facts, statistics, or information systematically.

words.ex: Scientists collect samples from the river to test for pollution.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们从河里采集样本以检测污染。

words.ex: He analyzes results every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上分析结果。
words.en: Examine data or information to draw conclusions.

words.tr: phrase. 解释发现；阐释结果
words.ex: The scientist interpret findings from the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家解释实验的发现。

words.tr: phrase. 理解；弄懂；明白；领会
words.ex: I can't make sense of this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂这个数学题。
words.en: To understand something that is complicated or unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 推断从（所给事实）推论出…
words.ex: We can deduce from the facts that he is not telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以从事实中推断出他没有说实话。
words.en: To reach a conclusion by reasoning from the evidence or known facts.

words.tr: phrase. 产生结果；得出成果
words.ex: The new marketing strategy began to yield results within a month.
words.ex_cn: 新的营销策略在一个月内开始产生结果。
words.en: To produce or provide a result or outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 产生见解；得出洞见
words.ex: The data helps us produce insights about customer behavior.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据帮助我们产生关于客户行为的见解。

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 为...铺平道路；为...做好准备
words.ex: New technology can pave the way for better education.
words.ex_cn: 新技术可以为更好的教育铺平道路。
words.en: To make it easier for something to happen or for someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 为…奠定基础；为…做准备
words.ex: He laid the groundwork for the new project last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月为这个新项目打下了基础。
words.en: To prepare the necessary conditions or foundation for something to develop or succeed.

words.tr: 处于初期阶段；处于婴儿期；指某事物尚处于发展的最初阶段，尚未成熟或完善
words.ex: The technology is in its infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这项技术还处于初期阶段。
words.en: To be in a very early stage of development or existence.

words.tr: phrase. 处于初期阶段的；萌芽状态的
words.ex: The project is at a nascent stage.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目还处于初期阶段。

words.tr: phrase. 达到一个重要里程碑；取得重大进展
words.ex: The team reached a milestone when they finished the first phase.
words.ex_cn: 当团队完成第一阶段时，他们达到了一个重要里程碑。

words.ex: Scientists made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们在癌症研究方面取得了突破。
words.en: Achieve a significant and sudden advance in knowledge or technology.

words.tr: phrase. 卓越的效率；显著的效能
words.ex: The new machine shows remarkable efficiency in saving energy.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器展现出卓越的节能效率。

words.tr: phrase. 更高的精确度；优越的准确性
words.ex: This new tool has superior accuracy in measuring small distances.
words.ex_cn: 这种新工具在测量小距离时具有更高的精确度。

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.ex: This house uses energy-efficient lights.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子使用节能灯。
words.en: Designed to use as little energy as possible, especially in order to save money and protect the environment.

words.ex: He drives a fuel-efficient car.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆省油的车。
words.en: Designed to consume less fuel for a given amount of work or travel, thus saving energy and reducing emissions.

words.ex: The phone has a compact design that fits easily in your pocket.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机具有紧凑的设计，可以轻松放入口袋。

words.ex: The bike has a lightweight design to make it easier to ride.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车采用轻量化设计，使其更容易骑行。

words.tr: phrase. 可携式设计；便于携带的设计
words.ex: The laptop has a portable design for easy travel.
words.ex_cn: 这台笔记本电脑具有可携式设计，便于携带旅行。

words.tr: phrase. 耐用的结构；坚固的建造
words.ex: The house has a durable construction that lasts for decades.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有耐用的结构，可以使用数十年。
words.en: The quality of being built to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over time.

words.tr: phrase. 坚固的结构；结实的建造
words.ex: The house has a robust construction that can survive strong earthquakes.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有坚固的结构，能够抵御强烈地震。

words.tr: phrase. 坚固的结构；结实的建造
words.ex: The shed has a sturdy construction and lasts for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小屋有坚固的结构，能使用很多年。

words.tr: phrase. 尖端的；精密复杂的；高度发达的技术
words.ex: The phone uses sophisticated technology.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机使用了先进的技术。
words.en: Advanced and complex technology, often implying a high level of development and refinement.

words.ex: He uses advanced technology to fix phones.
words.ex_cn: 他使用先进技术来修理手机。
words.en: Advanced technology refers to the application of the latest or most sophisticated techniques or equipment in a particular field.

words.ex: This company uses cutting-edge technology to make phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用尖端技术来制造手机。
words.en: Cutting-edge technology refers to the latest and most advanced technology available in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 最先进的；达到最高水平的
words.ex: This hospital has state-of-the-art equipment.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院拥有最先进的设备。
words.en: The most advanced or sophisticated level of development, as of a device, technique, or scientific field, achieved at a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 高度发达的；高度发展的
words.ex: Japan is a highly developed country with advanced technology and infrastructure.
words.ex_cn: 日本是一个高度发达的国家，拥有先进的技术和基础设施。
words.en: Having reached an advanced stage of development, especially in technology or economic systems.

words.tr: adj. 有成本效益的；划算的
words.ex: This bike is cost-effective and saves money.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车物有所值，能省钱。
words.en: Something that is cost-effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.tr: phrase. 用户友好的界面；易于使用的界面
words.ex: The app has a user-friendly interface.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序有一个用户友好的界面。
words.en: A design that is easy for people to understand and use without difficulty.

words.ex: The app has an intuitive interface that even children can use.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序有一个直观的界面，连孩子都能使用。

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.ex: The ecosystem is a self-regulating system that maintains its balance without human intervention.
words.ex_cn: 生态系统是一个自我调节的系统，无需人类干预即可保持其平衡。
words.en: Capable of controlling or adjusting itself without external intervention.

words.tr: adj. 自动操作的；自运行的
words.ex: The self-operating machine works without human help.
words.ex_cn: 这台自动操作的机器不需要人工帮助就能工作。

words.tr: phrase. 处理数据；对数据进行加工处理
words.ex: The computer processes data quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机快速处理数据。
words.en: To handle or manipulate data, especially by a computer, to produce information.

words.tr: phrase. 传输数据；传送资料
words.ex: The phone can transmit data quickly.
words.ex_cn: 手机可以快速传输数据。
words.en: To send electronic signals or data from one device to another.
